review_scope: All eight pages of the archived official Polish Striker MY26 cennik; focus on page-5 option/package matrix, package descriptions, legends, notes and cross-references.

p_marker.source_observation: The printed P marker occurs in the Expression/Extreme grade cells for the heated washer nozzles and windscreen row. No legend, footnote, note or cross-reference in the eight-page cennik defines its meaning.
p_marker.disposition: Keep all seven configuration mappings as unknown. Do not reinterpret P as standard, optional, package-included, unavailable or any other status. Do not infer a package relationship or standalone price.

cross_checks: The page-4/5 equipment matrix confirms the panoramic glass roof as standard in Extreme and priced optional equipment in Journey; this does not define the P marker.
The printed page-5 package descriptions identify named package contents but do not define the P marker or link it to those packages.

conclusion: Package composition is explicitly stated for six named packages. The P marker remains undefined by this cennik. No new master-data values, availability mappings, package-component equipment records or commercial mappings are justified.
limitations: Review is limited to the archived 2026-11-02 Polish cennik; brochures, configurator and external interpretation were excluded.
No claim is made about the meaning of P in other Dacia documents or model years.
